name: @finch/finch
description: Node.js bindings for the Finch memory layer

scripts.build: cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib finch-node index.node -- cargo build -p finch-node --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.build-release: cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib finch-node index.node -- cargo build -p finch-node --message-format=json-render-diagnostics --release
